title: Stage-2 test: does local variance heterogeneity explain the conditioned-moment shortfall?
status: Frozen after Benchmark 014 revealed a ~3% systematic shortfall (particle) and a lag-1/2 failure (empty trap), and before any stratified statistic was computed. The data are already inspected, so this is a post hoc hypothesis test on the same data; a confirmation would still need fresh data. No novelty claim.
hypothesis: H: slowly varying variance of the measured velocity (noise power or otherwise) makes |W|<=b selection favour low-variance stretches, biasing observed conditional second moments below a single stationary Gaussian prediction.

design.data_scope: Second halves (Benchmark 014 test halves) of all six traces, particle and empty trap separately.
design.proxy_secondary: Segment mean of (fourth difference of Y)^2 / 70, a high-frequency noise-power proxy.
design.strata: Quartiles of the proxy across all segments of a role; the unstratified case (1 stratum) is the baseline.
design.placebo: Segment-to-stratum labels randomly permuted (seed 2026100621), same stratum sizes.
design.prediction: For each stratum, u, r, s from that stratum's unconditional moments (centred by the role's global test-half means); stratum prediction from the measurement-level identity with the global b. Combined prediction = selected-count-weighted average of stratum predictions; observed = pooled conditional mean of D_k^2.
design.uncertainty: Segment bootstrap within each trace, 300 replicates, seed 2026100622.

self_tests.positive: Lab 34 stationary synthetic: stratification must change the mean signed relative error by less than 0.01 in absolute value.
self_tests.negative: Lab 34 modulated-noise synthetic: stratification must reduce |mean signed relative error| by at least 50%.
self_tests.rule: If either self-test fails, the real-data result is reported as NOT INTERPRETABLE.

decision.metric: Mean signed relative error over the 12 lags at the primary bin, e_unstrat and e_strat; placebo e_placebo.
decision.supported: H SUPPORTED for a role if |e_strat| <= 0.5*|e_unstrat|, and |e_placebo| >= 0.75*|e_unstrat|.
